variant.author: Saevath
variant.changelog:
**New Plugin**: Glamour Roulette is a plugin for Final Fantasy XIV that randomly selects one of your saved Glamour Plates and swaps to it.
- Allows the user to select eligible gearsets to be randomized.
- Don't know what to wear tonight? Glamour Roulette has you covered!
variant.description: Listen to your favorite internet radio stations directly in-game. Browse stations and manage your favorites. Use /cradio to open the radio player
variant.name: CrystalRadio
variant.punchline: Stream internet radio stations while playing FFXIV
